ad.description: Active Directory attack reference: ACL-right to attack-primitive matrix, Kerberos ticket errors and tgtdeleg, dMSA/badSuccessor abuse, RBCD, shadow credentials, delegation, tombstone reanimation, BloodHound queries. Use when attacking AD/Windows domains or when Kerberos errors appear.

adcs.description: Active Directory Certificate Services: ESC1-16 with certipy commands, certificate-based authentication. Use when ADCS/PKI is detected or certipy finds vulnerable templates.

windows.description: Windows lateral movement with credentials: execution method priority, failure triage, privilege escalation, flag and secret locations. Use when you have Windows credentials or a low-priv Windows shell.

linux.description: Linux privilege escalation: SUID/SGID, sudo, capabilities, cron, writable paths, kernel exploits, automated enumeration. Use when you have a Linux shell and need to escalate.

forensics.description: Offline credential extraction from memory/disk images: volatility3 hive dump plus secretsdump LOCAL, VM backup shares, LSASS credential plugins. Use when you find .vmem/.vmsn/.vhd/.vhdx files or VM backups.

env.description: Lab environment gotchas and tool syntax: clock skew, /etc/hosts hygiene, NAT port limits, impacket/bloodyAD/nxc/certipy flag quirks, VM reset behavior. Use when tools fail unexpectedly or after a target reset.

web.description: Web application and API attacks: directory/vhost/parameter fuzzing, SQLi, NoSQLi, SSTI, SSRF, XXE, JWT, LFI/RFI, file upload bypass, GraphQL, brute force, WebSocket testing, nuclei scanning, wordlist paths. Use when attacking web apps or APIs.
